about: Official sources for how a private individual's gain from selling Bitcoin is taxed in tax year 2026 in the 13 countries of the Loan & Liquidity Copilot / Tax Agent. loanRate = the single short-term rate for the calculator (decimal); 0 where the sale itself is not taxed; null if no official confirmation. Each source URL was fetched and returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-12; quotes are copied from that source. Indicative, not tax advice; needs the tax advisor's review.

countries.name: Czechia
countries.condition: 15% income tax (23% on the part of the tax base above 36x the average wage); exempt if held more than 3 years, or if total crypto sale proceeds in the year do not exceed CZK 100,000.
countries.sourceTitle: Finanční správa: Daň z příjmů – Obecné informace (rate); exemption text: financnisprava.gov.cz/assets/cs/prilohy/d-placeni-dani/Krypto-29_4_2026.pdf
countries.quote: pro část základu daně do 36násobku průměrné mzdy se použije sazba daně 15 % a pro část základu daně nad 36násobek … 23 %
countries.notes: Exemption verified from the statute text of § 4(1)(zj) and (zk) ZDP (as amended by Act 32/2025, effective 15 Feb 2025) reproduced in a Koordinační výbor 04/26 paper hosted on financnisprava.gov.cz: '(zk) … přesáhne-li doba mezi nabytím a úplatným převodem … dobu 3 let' and '(zj) … pokud jejich úhrn … nepřesáhne … 100 000 Kč'. The 3-year exemption is capped at CZK 40 million a year (§ 4(3), shared with securities). Difference from site: the site mentions the 3-year test but not the CZK 100,000 gross-proceeds annual exemption or the 40 M cap. 2026 23% threshold: CZK 1,762,812.

gainTax.sourceTitle: Finanční správa: Daň z příjmů – Obecné informace
gainTax.quote: se použije sazba daně 15 % a pro část základu daně nad 36násobek průměrné mzdy se použije sazba daně 23 %
gainTax.notes: Rates for the individual's total tax base (§ 16 ZDP), which includes § 10 other income such as crypto sales. The page shows the 36x-average-wage threshold as CZK 1,762,812 labelled '2025'.

exemption.text: Tax-free after 3 years of holding (up to CZK 40 million a year), or if total crypto sale proceeds in the year are at most CZK 100,000
exemption.sourceTitle: Finanční správa: Osvobození příjmů z úplatného převodu kryptoaktiv (KV 29.4.2026, quotes § 4(1)(zk) ZDP as amended by Act 32/2025)
exemption.quote: přesáhne -li doba mezi nabytím a úplatným převodem tohoto kryptoaktiva při jeho úplatném převodu dobu 3 let
exemption.notes: Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. CORRECTION: incomplete. The same statute text also exempts all crypto sale proceeds of up to CZK 100,000 a year (§ 4(1)(zj) ZDP: 'pokud jejich úhrn u poplatníka nepřesáhne ve zdaňovacím období částku 100 000 Kč'); neither exemption applies to crypto held as business assets; the 3-year exemption is capped at CZK 40 million a year (§ 4(3)). Suggested text: 'Tax-free after 3 years (time test), or if total crypto sale proceeds in the year are CZK 100,000 or less'.

filing.sourceTitle: Finanční správa: Daň z příjmů fyzických osob – Obecné informace (§ 38g ZDP)
filing.quote: Daňové přiznání je povinen podat každý, jehož roční příjmy, které jsou předmětem daně z příjmů fyzických osob, přesáhly 50 000 Kč
filing.notes: General annual return duty (DAP FO), due 1 April (later if e-filed/adviser; not checked here). That a non-business crypto sale is § 10 'ostatní příjem' (Annex 2 of the DAP) is stated in GFR's crypto information (financnisprava.gov.cz/assets/cs/prilohy/d-seznam-dani/Info_kryptomeny_GFR.pdf, 2018): 'nebo jako příjem podle § 10 zákona o daních z příjmů (tj. ostatní příjem)'. Exempt income is not reported (financnisprava.gov.cz …/fyzicke-osoby/ostatni: 'Příjmy osvobozené se do daňového přiznání neuvádí').

countries.name: Slovakia
countries.condition: Crypto sale = other income (§ 8(1)(t)); progressive 19% up to €43,983.32, 25% to €60,349.21, 30% to €75,010.32, 35% above (2026); no holding-period exemption; losses ignored.
countries.sourceTitle: Finančná správa: Sadzba dane z príjmov fyzickej osoby za rok 2026 (+ podpora.financnasprava.sk/293880 Príjmy z predaja kryptoaktív u nepodnikateľa)
countries.quote: z ostatných príjmov (§ 8) 19 % z tej časti základu dane, ktorá nepresiahne sumu 43 983,32 eura vrátane
countries.notes: Update 2026-10-13: the 16% health insurance contribution is now verified separately in fields.healthLevy (VšZP + Act 580/2004 § 13(7), § 38ezk). Verified for the income tax part only. The crypto page (293880) confirms taxation under § 8(1)(t), that expenses above income are ignored, and that health/social insurance 'which the taxpayer must pay from this type of income' is deductible, but it does not state the health levy rate. The site's calculator uses 0.35 (19% + 16% health contributions); the 16% health levy was NOT verified from an official source (only press). Site's gainTax '19–35%' matches the 2026 bands; consider 0.19 (income tax) or 0.35 only once the health-insurance rate is confirmed (zákon 580/2004, VšZP/ÚDZS).

gainTax.sourceTitle: Finančná správa: Sadzba dane z príjmov fyzickej osoby za rok 2026
gainTax.quote: z ostatných príjmov (§ 8) 19 % z tej časti základu dane, ktorá nepresiahne sumu 43 983,32 eura vrátane
gainTax.notes: Update 2026-10-13: the 16% health insurance contribution is now verified separately in fields.healthLevy (VšZP + Act 580/2004 § 13(7), § 38ezk). Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. Only partly verified: the 19/25/30/35% bands for § 8 income in 2026 are on this page (crypto = § 8(1)(t) per podpora.financnasprava.sk/293880). The '16% health contributions' part is NOT on any official page checked; the crypto page only says health/social insurance due on this income is deductible. Needs an official source (zákon 580/2004 / VšZP / ÚDZS) before marking verified.

healthLevy.text: 16% health insurance contributions on the gain (8% with a disability), settled annually by the health insurer
healthLevy.quote: zamestnanec, samostatne zárobkovo činná osoba, samoplatiteľ a poistenec štátu bez zdravotného postihnutia, ktorý má príjem z kapitálového majetku a ostatných príjmov, z pôvodných 15 % na 16 %
healthLevy.notes: Legal basis: Act 580/2004 § 10b(1)(d), § 13(7), § 38ezk (16% for 2026 and 2027; 15% in 2024 and 2025), https://static.slov-lex.sk/static/SK/ZZ/2004/580/20260701.html. Crypto sale and swap income is § 8(1)(t) ZDP (https://static.slov-lex.sk/static/SK/ZZ/2003/595/20260101.html). Base = § 8 tax base (gain after costs), no cap. Applies to employees, self-employed, self-payers and state-insured. Annual settlement by the insurer by 30 Sep of the following year; arrears due within 45 days. Contributions are deductible against this income (Finančná správa 293880). No official page names crypto together with the rate.

exemption.text: No holding-period exemption; every sale or crypto-to-crypto swap is taxed
exemption.sourceTitle: Finančná správa: Príjmy z predaja kryptoaktív u nepodnikateľa
exemption.quote: Predajom kryptoaktíva je výmena kryptoaktíva za majetok výmena kryptoaktíva za iné kryptoaktívum
exemption.notes: Partly verified: the page confirms every sale and crypto-to-crypto exchange is taxable under § 8(1)(t) and sets no holding-period condition, but it does not explicitly say 'no holding-period exemption'. (The old URL podpora.financnasprava.sk/293880 now returns 404; this is the working URL.)

filing.text: Annual personal tax return (type B), due 31 March
filing.sourceTitle: Finančná správa: Povinnosť podať daňové priznanie k dani z príjmov FO za rok 2026
filing.quote: Daňovník je povinný podať daňové priznanie k dani z príjmov fyzickej osoby za rok 2026 (typ B), a to v lehote do 31. marca 2027.
filing.notes: Same page: an employee with other taxable income, e.g. '(§ 8)', 'vysporiada si svoju daňovú povinnosť podaním daňového priznania k dani z príjmov FO typu B'. Deadline also on podpora.financnasprava.sk/534611 ('za rok 2026 je 31. marca 2027'); it can be extended by up to 3 months.

countries.name: Poland
countries.condition: 19% on income from paid disposal of virtual currency (PIT-38); no holding-period exemption; crypto-to-crypto swaps not taxed.
countries.sourceTitle: Serwis o podatkach – Zbycie kryptowalut (Ministerstwo Finansów)
countries.quote: Podatek oblicz od dochodu. Stawka podatku wynosi 19%.
countries.notes: Matches site. Page also states 'Wymiana pomiędzy walutami wirtualnymi … nie podlega opodatkowaniu'. Possible 4% solidarity levy on income above PLN 1 million not checked.

gainTax.sourceTitle: Serwis o podatkach – Zbycie kryptowalut (Ministerstwo Finansów)
gainTax.notes: Tax on income (proceeds minus costs). Existing source URL podatki.gov.pl/pit/rozliczenie-ze-sprzedazy-kryptowalut/ redirects here. It is a PIT rate on income from disposal of virtual currency, not a separate capital gains tax (wording only). 4% solidarity levy above PLN 1M not checked.

exemption.sourceTitle: Serwis o podatkach – Zbycie kryptowalut (Ministerstwo Finansów)
exemption.quote: Podatek oblicz od dochodu. Stawka podatku wynosi 19%
exemption.notes: Not explicitly stated: the page taxes every paid disposal with no holding-period condition, but does not say 'no holding-period exemption' in words.

filing.sourceTitle: Serwis o podatkach – Zbycie kryptowalut (Ministerstwo Finansów)
filing.notes: Same page: 'Zeznanie składasz w terminie od 15 lutego do 30 kwietnia roku następującego po roku podatkowym'; costs must be reported even in years without a sale.

countries.name: Austria
countries.condition: 27.5% special rate for crypto acquired after 28 February 2021 (no holding exemption); crypto acquired up to 28 Feb 2021 ('Altbestand') stays under the old regime.
countries.quote: unterliegen gemäß § 27a Abs 1 EStG einem besonderen Steuersatz in Höhe von 27,5 Prozent
countries.notes: Page: new regime applies to crypto 'die nach dem 28. Februar 2021 angeschafft wurden'; older holdings are 'Altbestände … weiterhin die Besteuerung wie vor der ökosozialen Steuerreform'. The page does NOT spell out the old 1-year speculation period, so the site's '0% after 1 year if bought before March 2021' is plausible (old § 31 EStG) but not verified from this page. Cut-off: site says 'before March 2021' = correct (acquired by 28 Feb 2021).

gainTax.quote: unterliegen gemäß § 27a Abs 1 EStG einem besonderen Steuersatz in Höhe von 27,5 Prozent
gainTax.notes: 27.5% special rate for crypto acquired after 28 Feb 2021; collected as KESt by Austrian providers, otherwise assessed in the return at the same rate.

exemption.text: Tax-free after 1 year only for crypto bought before March 2021; later purchases have no exemption
exemption.sourceTitle: RIS: § 31 EStG 1988 Spekulationsgeschäfte (version in force from 1.4.2012, i.e. the pre-reform rule)
exemption.quote: der Zeitraum zwischen Anschaffung und Veräußerung nicht mehr als ein Jahr beträgt
exemption.notes: Verified by combining two official sources: BMF crypto page says holdings bought up to 28 Feb 2021 are 'Altbestände … weiterhin die Besteuerung wie vor der ökosozialen Steuerreform', and the pre-reform § 31 EStG taxes private sales only within one year. Crypto bought later falls under § 27b with no holding exemption (BMF page). The § 31 €440 Freigrenze was not checked.

filing.text: Annual return for gains via foreign exchanges; Austrian providers withhold the tax
filing.sourceTitle: BMF: Formular E 1kv 2024 (Beilage zur Einkommensteuererklärung, Einkünfte aus Kapitalvermögen; section 1.3.5 Kryptowährungen)
filing.quote: Erklärungspflicht für - Kapitaleinkünfte ohne KESt-Abzug (insbesondere ausländische Kapitaleinkünfte)
filing.notes: Form has crypto fields for foreign realized gains (KZ 174). Domestic withholding per BMF crypto page: 'besteht für inländische Schuldner und Dienstleister die Verpflichtung, für die erzielten Kapitalerträge Kapitalertragsteuer (KESt) abzuziehen' (for income after 31 Dec 2023). The 2024 form version was checked; the 2025/2026 form was not.

countries.name: Germany
countries.condition: Private sale taxed at the personal progressive rate (0–45%; 42% band for taxable income €69,879–277,825) if held 1 year or less; tax-free after more than 1 year; total private-sale gains under €1,000 a year are tax-free.
countries.quote: bei denen der Zeitraum zwischen Anschaffung und Veräußerung nicht mehr als ein Jahr beträgt
countries.notes: § 23(3): 'Gewinne bleiben steuerfrei, wenn … Gesamtgewinn im Kalenderjahr weniger als 1 000 Euro betragen hat' (Freigrenze, not allowance). § 32a: '0,42 • x' for €69,879–277,825 and '0,45 • x' from €277,826. 0.42 is a high-income marginal rate, not typical; solidarity surcharge/church tax excluded. That crypto falls under 'andere Wirtschaftsgüter' is BMF administrative practice (not quoted here). Site's '0% after 1 year' matches; site does not mention the €1,000 Freigrenze.

gainTax.notes: Top marginal rate 45% of the progressive tariff; solidarity surcharge and church tax not included.

exemption.text: 0% after a 1-year holding period; total gains under €1,000 a year are tax-free
exemption.sourceTitle: BMF-Schreiben vom 6. März 2025: Einzelfragen zur ertragsteuerrechtlichen Behandlung bei virtuellen Währungen und sonstigen Token (Rz. 53)
exemption.quote: darstellen, wenn der Zeitraum zwischen der Anschaffung und der Veräußerung nicht mehr als ein Jahr beträgt
exemption.notes: Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. BMF Rz. 53: crypto are 'andere Wirtschaftsgüter' under § 23(1) no. 2 EStG, taxable only if sold within one year; Rz. 63: no 10-year extension for currency/payment tokens. CORRECTION: incomplete. Within the year, total private-sale gains under €1,000 are tax-free (§ 23(3) EStG, Freigrenze: 'wenn der aus den privaten Veräußerungsgeschäften erzielte Gesamtgewinn im Kalenderjahr weniger als 1 000 Euro betragen hat'); consider adding it.

filing.quote: In den Zeilen 45 bis 49 sowie 56 und 57 machen Sie Angaben zu Kryptowerten
filing.notes: Short-term (≤ 1 year) crypto sales go in Anlage SO of the annual income tax return. Line numbers are for the 2025 form.

countries.name: Hungary
countries.condition: 15% personal income tax on the annual net gain from crypto transactions; no holding-period exemption; small transactions exempt under minimum-wage-linked limits.
countries.quote: A kriptoeszközzel végrehajtott ügyletekből az adóévben elért ügyleti nyereség után 15 százalék személyi jövedelemadót kell fizetni.
countries.notes: Matches site. The NAV page is written for the 2021/2022 returns (Szja tv. § 67/C); the rule is unchanged as far as checked but the page is not 2026-specific. Losses can be offset via 'adókiegyenlítés' over the previous 2 years.

gainTax.quote: A kriptoeszközzel végrehajtott ügyletekből az adóévben elért ügyleti nyereség után 15 százalék személyi jövedelemadót kell fizetni.
gainTax.notes: Officially a 15% personal income tax (Szja tv. § 67/C) on the annual net crypto gain, not a separate 'capital gains tax' (wording only). Page written for the 2021/2022 returns.

exemption.text: No holding-period exemption; small transactions up to 10% of the minimum wage each are tax-free (up to one minimum wage a year in total)
exemption.quote: Nem kell adózni , ha az ügyletből származó bevétel nem több, mint a minimálbér 10 százaléka
exemption.notes: Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. The page sets no holding-period condition but does not say 'no holding-period exemption' in words. CORRECTION: incomplete. Small transactions are tax-free: proceeds per transaction up to 10% of the minimum wage, if no other crypto income that day and the year's total of such proceeds does not exceed the minimum wage (amounts on the page are 2021 figures).

filing.quote: A kriptoügyletből származó jövedelmet a magánszemélynek az önállóan elkészített 21SZJA-bevallásában fel kell tüntetnie
filing.notes: Example is the 2021 return (21SZJA); the same annual SZJA return (or completing NAV's draft) applies each year. Due 20 May (not checked on this page).

countries.name: Slovenia
countries.condition: No income tax on capital gains from selling virtual currencies by a private individual, unless trading is carried on as a business activity.
countries.quote: se dohodnine ne plača pod pogojem, da fizična oseba ne dosega tovrstnih dohodkov v zvezi z opravljanjem dejavnosti
countries.notes: Site has no Loan preset for Slovenia (calculator would use 0). The site's claim that a proposed 25% tax was withdrawn in 2025 is from press (rtvslo.si: bill pulled from the December 2025 session); not verified on an official page. Re-check before 2027 in case the bill returns.

gainTax.text: No tax on private disposal gains (business trading is taxed)
gainTax.quote: se dohodnine ne plača pod pogojem, da fizična oseba ne dosega tovrstnih dohodkov v zvezi z opravljanjem dejavnosti
gainTax.notes: Business trading is taxed as business income (same page).

exemption.quote: se dohodnine ne plača pod pogojem, da fizična oseba ne dosega tovrstnih dohodkov v zvezi z opravljanjem dejavnosti
exemption.notes: Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. First part ('private gains are not taxed') verified. 'A proposed 25% tax was withdrawn in 2025' is NOT on an official page (press only: bill pulled from the December 2025 session); the FURS page was last updated 14.4.2025.

filing.text: None for private gains; mining income needs an advance-tax return within 15 days; business income goes on the business tax return
filing.sourceTitle: FURS: Davčna obravnava poslovanja z virtualnimi valutami po ZDoh-2, ZDDPO-2, ZDDV-1 in ZDFS (podrobnejši opis)
filing.quote: Napoved za odmero akontacije dohodnine od drugih dohodkov mora vložiti davčni zavezanec pri davčnem organu v petnajstih dneh od dneva prejema dohodka.
filing.notes: Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. 'None for private gains' is consistent with the sources. CORRECTION: mining by a private person (not a business) is 'drugi dohodek' (Art. 105 ZDoh-2): an advance-tax return must be filed within 15 days of receipt, and the income is then included in the annual dohodnina assessment ('Drugi dohodki se vštevajo tudi v letno davčno osnovo'). Business trading/mining is declared via the business income return (DDD). Suggested text: 'None for private gains; mining income: advance-tax return within 15 days (then annual assessment); business income: annual business return'.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.condition: 12% tax on capital gains; gains on crypto acquired more than 2 years before the sale are not taxed (still reported on JOPPD).
countries.sourceTitle: Porezna uprava: Primjer podnošenja Obrasca JOPPD za primitke po osnovi trgovanja kriptoimovinom (rate: porezna-uprava.gov.hr/hr/dohodak-od-kapitala-po-osnovi-kapitalnih-dobitaka/4653)
countries.quote: Ako je kapitalni dobitak ostvaren prodajom kriptoimovine koja je stečena prije više od dvije godine, takav dobitak ne oporezuje se porezom na dohodak.
countries.notes: Rate from the capital-gains page: '… umanjene za ostvarene kapitalne gubitke po stopi od 12%'. Matches site (12%, 2-year exemption, JOPPD even for exempt sales).

gainTax.sourceTitle: Porezna uprava: Dohodak od kapitala po osnovi kapitalnih dobitaka
gainTax.quote: umanjene za ostvarene kapitalne gubitke po stopi od 12%
gainTax.notes: Crypto gains are capital gains per the Porezna uprava JOPPD notice (…/8342). '(since 2024)' is not stated on these pages (rate change from 10% to 12% from 1 Jan 2024 not separately verified).

exemption.sourceTitle: Porezna uprava: Primjer podnošenja Obrasca JOPPD za primitke po osnovi trgovanja kriptoimovinom (6.2.2026)
exemption.quote: Ako je kapitalni dobitak ostvaren prodajom kriptoimovine koja je stečena prije više od dvije godine, takav dobitak ne oporezuje se porezom na dohodak.

filing.text: JOPPD form by the end of February (not the annual return)
filing.sourceTitle: Porezna uprava: Primjer podnošenja Obrasca JOPPD za primitke po osnovi trgovanja kriptoimovinom (6.2.2026)
filing.quote: porezni obveznik ima obvezu iskazivanja tog primitka putem Obrasca JOPPD
filing.notes: Deadline from the capital-gains page (…/4653): the taxpayer must 'obračunati, obustaviti i uplatiti do posljednjeg dana mjeseca veljače tekuće godine' for the previous year's gains. '(not the annual return)' is not stated in those words.

countries.name: Romania
countries.condition: 16% on the gain from transfers of virtual currency made from 1 Jan 2026 (10% before); gains under 200 lei per transaction are exempt if annual gains do not exceed 600 lei; no holding exemption.
countries.quote: prin aplicarea cotei de 16% asupra câştigului din transferul de monedă virtuală, determinat ca diferenţă pozitivă între preţul de vânzare şi preţul de achiziţie
countries.notes: Art. XIII: applies 'câştigurilor din transferul de monedă virtuală obţinute începând cu data de 1 ianuarie 2026'. Matches site (16% from 2026; 200/600 lei). Health contribution CASS may apply above income thresholds; not checked.

gainTax.text: 16% income tax on crypto gains (10% until 2025)
gainTax.sourceTitle: Legea nr. 239/2025 (published by ANAF), art. XII pct. 14 – new art. 116 alin. (21) Cod fiscal
gainTax.quote: prin aplicarea cotei de 16% asupra câştigului din transferul de monedă virtuală
gainTax.notes: Art. XIII: applies to gains 'obţinute începând cu data de 1 ianuarie 2026'. '(10% until 2025)' is not stated in this law text (it repeals the old art. 116(2)(c) without quoting it); not separately verified.

exemption.quote: Câştigul sub nivelul a 200 lei/tranzacţie nu se impozitează cu condiţia ca totalul câştigurilor într-un an fiscal să nu depăşească nivelul de 600 lei.
exemption.notes: The rule sets no holding-period condition, but the source does not say 'no holding-period exemption' in words. The 200/600 lei small-gain exemption (quoted) is already in the site's note.

filing.sourceTitle: Legea nr. 239/2025 (published by ANAF), new art. 116 alin. (21) Cod fiscal
filing.quote: impozitul pe venit datorat se calculează de către contribuabil, pe baza Declaraţiei unice privind impozitul pe venit şi contribuţiile sociale datorate de persoanele fizice
filing.notes: Annual 'Declarația unică'. The law places crypto gains in art. 114 alin. (2) lit. m) Cod fiscal; that art. 114 is the 'venituri din alte surse' chapter is not quoted in this text. CASS may apply; not checked.

countries.name: Bulgaria
countries.condition: 10% tax on the annual tax base; crypto gains (net of the year's losses) are reduced by 10% deemed expenses, so the effective rate on the gain is about 9%; no holding-period exemption.
countries.quote: сумата от реализираните през годината печалби … намалена със сумата от реализираните през годината загуби … се намалява с 10 на сто разходи
countries.notes: Rate from the NRA personal income tax page: 'Размер на данъка 10 % от данъчната основа'. Matches site's 10%; site could add the 10% deemed-expense reduction (effective ≈9%). No advance tax; declared in Annex 5.

gainTax.sourceTitle: НАП: Данък върху доходите на физическите лица
gainTax.quote: Размер на данъка 10 % от данъчната основа за доходите, които сте придобили през предходната година.
gainTax.notes: Crypto page (nra.bg …/virtualni-valuti): the year's net crypto gain is reduced by 10% deemed expenses, so the effective rate on the gain is about 9%.

exemption.quote: се намалява с 10 на сто разходи
exemption.notes: The page sets no holding-period condition but does not say 'no holding-period exemption' in words.

filing.quote: Тези доходи трябва да декларирате в Приложение № 5 на годишната данъчна декларация

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.condition: No tax on the sale itself; crypto is a Box 3 asset taxed at 36% on a deemed return (6.00% for 'other assets' in the 2026 provisional assessment), above a €59,357 tax-free allowance per person (2026).
countries.sourceTitle: Belastingdienst: Hoe is het box 3-inkomen op mijn voorlopige aanslag 2026 berekend? (+ …/werk-en-inkomen/content/cryptovaluta, …/box-3/content/heffingsvrij-vermogen)
countries.quote: Vermenigvuldig het belastingtarief voor box 3 in 2026 (36%) met het voordeel uit sparen en beleggen
countries.notes: loanRate 0 because selling does not trigger tax; holding does (wealth on 1 January). Crypto page: 'Deze crypto's geeft u aan in box 3'. Allowance €59,357 (€118,714 with partner) confirmed. 6.00% is the provisional-assessment deemed return; the final 2026 figure may differ. Matches site.

gainTax.text: Box 3 wealth tax on a deemed return (about 36% of the assumed yield)
gainTax.sourceTitle: Belastingdienst: Hoe is het box 3-inkomen op mijn voorlopige aanslag 2026 berekend?
gainTax.quote: Vermenigvuldig het belastingtarief voor box 3 in 2026 (36%) met het voordeel uit sparen en beleggen
gainTax.notes: Deemed return for 'beleggingen en andere bezittingen' 6.00% (provisional 2026). Legally an income tax on a deemed return in box 3, not a separate wealth tax (wording only).

exemption.quote: Heffingsvrij vermogen zonder fiscale partner Heffingsvrij vermogen met fiscale partner 2026 € 59.357 € 118.714

filing.quote: Crypto's horen tot uw bezittingen in box 3. Van uw crypto's geeft u de waarde in het economisch verkeer aan op 1 januari (peildatum).
filing.notes: Declared in the box 3 part of the annual income tax return (aangifte inkomstenbelasting), valued at 1 January, not in a separate 'Box 3 declaration' (wording only).

countries.name: France
countries.condition: Flat tax (PFU) 31.4% = 12.8% income tax + 18.6% social charges on private-wealth crypto gains; option for the progressive scale; exempt if total disposal proceeds in the year are €305 or less; no holding exemption.
countries.sourceTitle: impots.gouv.fr: Comment déclarer les plus ou moins values sur cessions d'actifs numériques ?
countries.quote: imposées au prélèvement forfaitaire unique (PFU) de 31,4 % (12,8 % d'impôt + 18,6 % de prélèvements sociaux), quel que soit le nombre de transactions
countries.notes: Matches site (31.4%, €305). Older BOFiP pages still show 30% / 17.2% social charges (pre-2026). The site's earlier 30% (12.8 + 17.2) is outdated. Crypto-to-crypto swaps are in tax deferral ('sursis d'imposition') per the same page.

gainTax.text: 31.4% flat tax (PFU: 12.8% income tax + 18.6% social charges, 2026)
gainTax.sourceTitle: impots.gouv.fr: Comment déclarer les plus ou moins values sur cessions d'actifs numériques ?
gainTax.quote: prélèvement forfaitaire unique (PFU) de 31,4 % (12,8 % d’impôt + 18,6 % de prélèvements sociaux), quel que soit le nombre de transactions
gainTax.notes: Option for the progressive scale exists (same page).

exemption.text: No holding-period exemption; total disposals up to €305 a year are exempt
exemption.sourceTitle: impots.gouv.fr: Comment déclarer les plus ou moins values sur cessions d'actifs numériques ?
exemption.quote: la somme des prix de cession (montant annuel brut des cessions et non les plus-values), hors opération d’échange en sursis d’imposition, n’excède pas 305 €
exemption.notes: The €305 exemption (on gross annual proceeds, not gains) is verified; 'no holding-period exemption' is not stated in words (the page taxes gains 'quel que soit le nombre de transactions' with no holding condition).

filing.text: Annual return with form 2086; foreign accounts on form 3916-bis
filing.sourceTitle: impots.gouv.fr: Comment déclarer les plus ou moins values sur cessions d'actifs numériques ?
filing.quote: Indiquez le total de la plus‑value ou de la moins‑value de l’année dans la déclaration annexe n° 2086
filing.notes: Same page on foreign platform accounts: 'vous devez les déclarer en remplissant l’imprimé n°3916-3916 bis' (paper) or at the end of the online return.

countries.name: Spain
countries.condition: Gains go to the savings base: combined state + regional scale 19% to €6,000, 21% €6,000–50,000, 23% €50,000–200,000, 27% €200,000–300,000, 30% above; no holding exemption.
countries.sourceTitle: BOE: Ley 35/2006 del IRPF (consolidated, updated 07/10/2026), arts. 66 and 76
countries.notes: Art. 66 (state) and art. 76 (regional) each give 9.5/10.5/11.5/13.5/15%, summing to 19/21/23/27/30% (top band 15%+15% since 1 Jan 2025, Ley 7/2024). 0.21 is the band for €6k–50k as the site labels it; small gains (<€6k) are 19%. That crypto gains are ganancias patrimoniales in the savings base (art. 46) was not separately quoted. Matches site.

gainTax.sourceTitle: BOE: Ley 35/2006 del IRPF (consolidated), art. 66 Tipos de gravamen del ahorro (+ art. 76 regional)
gainTax.notes: State scale 9.5/10.5/11.5/13.5/15% plus identical regional scale (art. 76) = 19/21/23/27/30%. AEAT IRPF 2025 manual: crypto sale gains 'constituyen renta del ahorro conforme a lo previsto en el artículo 46. b) de la Ley del IRPF'.

exemption.sourceTitle: Agencia Tributaria: Manual práctico Renta 2025 – Compra y venta de monedas virtuales: tributación en el IRPF del inversor
exemption.quote: constituyen renta del ahorro conforme a lo previsto en el artículo 46. b) de la Ley del IRPF
exemption.notes: No holding-period condition is mentioned, but the source does not say 'no holding-period exemption' in words.

filing.text: Annual IRPF return; Modelo 721 for crypto held with custodians abroad over €50,000
filing.sourceTitle: Agencia Tributaria: Manual práctico Renta 2025 – Compra y venta de monedas virtuales (+ Preguntas frecuentes modelo 721)
filing.quote: deberán ser incluidas en la declaración del IRPF correspondiente al período impositivo en que dichas operaciones se hayan realizado
filing.notes: Text updated 2026-10-13 to the sourced facts. Modelo 721 threshold (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es …/preguntas-frecuentes-sobre-modelo-721/respecto-que-monedas-virtuales-no-informacion.html): 'No existirá obligación de informar … cuando los saldos a 31 de diciembre … no superen, conjuntamente, los 50.000 euros'. CORRECTION: precision. Modelo 721 covers only crypto held with a custodian outside Spain (third party holding the keys); self-custody wallets are not included (AEAT 721 FAQ). Suggested: 'Modelo 721 for crypto held with foreign custodians over €50,000'.

fieldsAbout: fields = the three facts shown on /bitcoin-tax/<country>/ (seo-data.json gainTax/exemption/filing), each with an official source checked 2026-10-13. Optional fourth field healthLevy (Slovakia only): health insurance contributions due on the gain, shown as its own card in the Tax Agent and its own row on the guide, with its own source. text = the site's current text (unchanged). verified = true only if the official source itself states the fact; notes starting with 'CORRECTION:' mean the site text is wrong or incomplete per the source.
